_original_lore: Can be consumed inside a Kuudra
chest to reroll the Shard inside into
May the eternal luck of Kuudra be in your favor.
name: 命运之轮

source: Can be consumed inside a Kuudra
chest to reroll the Shard inside into
loreParagraphs.translation: 可在库德拉宝箱中消耗,将箱内的碎片重掷为更高稀有度的碎片.

source: May the eternal luck of Kuudra be in your favor.
loreParagraphs.translation: 愿库德拉的永恒好运与你同在.
